entries.english: Add automatic API host selection: reuse a valid cached route, otherwise probe startup candidates concurrently and persist the fastest host; expose explicit public SDK support and make auto the CLI default while preserving explicit hosts. Configuration creation is atomic, update proxy resolution is independent of JavDB host settings, invalid proxy ports and negative retries are rejected, and unmark sends large review IDs as exact decimals.
entries.zh_cn: 新增 API 自动选线：缓存线路有效时直接复用，否则并发探测 startup 候选并持久化最快主机；提供显式 public SDK 支持，并在保留显式 host 的同时将 auto 设为 CLI 默认值。配置文件以原子方式创建，update 代理解析不再依赖 JavDB host 设置，非法 proxy 端口和负重试次数会被拒绝，unmark 也会以精确十进制发送大 review ID。

entries.english: Retire the SkillHub publisher, keep ClawHub as the active Agent skill distribution path, and document public ClawHub installation with version pinning.
entries.zh_cn: 退役 SkillHub 发布器，保留 ClawHub 作为当前 Agent skill 分发路径，并记录公开 ClawHub 安装与版本固定方法。

entries.english: Verify ClawHub publication through its public skill endpoint without exposing publisher credentials during moderation.
entries.zh_cn: 通过 ClawHub 的公开 skill endpoint 验证发布结果，避免在审核期间暴露发布凭据。

entries.english: Remove internal compatibility facades and realign the CLI around real commands; split app capabilities into invocation, client and authstore packages, and unify movie, magnet and named projections under result without changing public contracts.
entries.zh_cn: 移除内部兼容 facade 并按真实命令重整 CLI；将 app 能力拆分为 invocation、client、authstore 包，并把 movie、magnet 与 named 投影统一到 result，保持公开契约不变。
